paper_000.title: Structural puzzles in virology solved with an overarching icosahedral design principle
key_extractions: Archimedean lattices (hexagonal, trihexagonal, snub hexagonal, rhombitrihexagonal) for icosahedral polyhedra
T-numbers scaled by lattice factors α_t=4/3, α_s=7/3, α_r≈2.49
Alternative capsid layouts e.g. T_t(1,1)=4 matching CK T=4 but different CP arrangement
HK97 lineage examples: Basilisk T_t(3,0)=12, HSV-1 T_t(4,0)=64/3
paper_000.relevance: Core theory for multi-shell icosahedral packing beyond Caspar-Klug; chiral and achiral shells

paper_001.title: High-entropy nanoparticles: Synthesis-structure-property relationships

Applications in catalysis with tunable activity/stability
paper_001.relevance: Analogous to multi-component nanoclusters; size mismatch relates to mixing entropy

paper_002.relevance: Self-assembly paths and shell sequences via Boolean satisfiability
